description: Purpose of this region: security-relevant findings for this installation and what became of them.
content:
This region records what has been found, fixed or accepted regarding the safety of this site.

Belongs here: exposures found and closed, hardening in place and the reason for it, checks performed and their result, and risks knowingly accepted along with who accepted them.

Findings from the error log belong here when they bear on safety — failed or forged authentication, denied and blocked access, suspicious requests, anything that exposed data or could have. Ordinary defects in this site's own code go to scope.site_development; errors caused by the server or its configuration go to scope.site_environment. Whichever region a finding lands in, use the error's own wording as a mnemonic: cross-region search matches on mnemonics, so that is what lets the next reader find it from anywhere.

Does not belong here: credentials, API keys or tokens of any kind. Memory is shared with everyone holding reader rights on the region, and a secret written here cannot be taken back. Never record, reconstruct or quote a key.

Record the verdict, not only the finding. "Checked, not exploitable, because X" is as valuable as a fix and stops the same ground being covered repeatedly.
